metaTitle: Custom Vinyl Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom vinyl lanyards and badges for your team. Durable, waterproof, and perfect for events. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Vinyl lanyards offer a durable, waterproof option for badges, IDs, and keys, making them ideal for outdoor events, trade shows, or industrial settings where standard fabric lanyards might wear out quickly. Unlike woven or polyester styles, vinyl resists moisture and stains, so your custom logo stays crisp through daily use. Whether you need breakaway safety features or full-color imprinting, vinyl lanyards provide a practical, long-lasting branding solution for bulk orders.
heroAltText: Custom vinyl lanyards and badges with full-color imprinting, breakaway clasp, and metal hardware for events
